_about: Every master in this repository: one entry per companion and pose; several poses may name the same file. A picture is outside archive/ only if something uses it: a pose, a launcher icon or an exported moment picture. kind is core or extension for poses in poses.json, picture for other per-companion art (moment, notification and icon pictures). origin is shigeyuki for a file of Shigeyuki's Anki-tan asset pack v1.0, unchanged (pack is its path in the pack), derivative for art AnkiQuest made from his Anki-tan, ankiquest for AnkiQuest's own companions; author is who to credit. framing is full_body, bust (head and shoulders or waist up) or headshot (the head only); face and the launcher icons are headshots and every other master is full_body (AGENTS.md, Companion art), checked with use by tools/art-check. shared lists pictures of more than one companion. missing lists the core poses a companion has no master for yet, tracked in AnkiQuest-Server#57; extensions without a master show their fallback and are not listed. archive lists what archive/ holds, which is never exported: retired pictures one by one, with the master that replaced them and, where known, the source commit and path they came from, and the rest of Shigeyuki's pack by folder.
